Get Started
Join our team
We’re building technology to revolutionize the future of work.See Open Positions
Our why
At Mimica, we're united by a bold mission: to empower individuals to reclaim their most precious resource — time. Our journey began with a vision of effortless automation, handing monotonous tasks over to AI to “mimic”, freeing people to focus on their most engaging work. 
Now, we’re making this vision a reality. We’ve developed groundbreaking technology that automatically translates the click and keystrokes that make up a team’s work into comprehensive process maps, helping the world’s largest enterprises optimize their processes. 
To grow our platform, we’re looking for colleagues who share our passion for building new technologies and solving complex technical challenges.
Who we are
We’re a remote-first team of machine learning experts, software engineers, data scientists, marketers, and sales leaders globally — and growing.

Our values
Trust & Communication
Our working philosophy is built on two principles: trust in each individual's abilities and a commitment to frequent, open communication.
Transparency & Inclusion
We understand that achieving our common goals requires a collective effort, and to that end, we ensure that knowledge is accessible to all to make informed decisions.
Innovation through Diversity
We believe that innovation arises from bringing together unique perspectives to fuel creativity, and therefore that our diversity is our strength.
Feedback & Growth
We cultivate an environment where open discussions and respectfully challenging each other's ideas are encouraged as an opportunity for personal and professional development.
‍
User-Centric Philosophy
We believe in going above and beyond for our customers, exceeding expectations wherever possible to ensure that our efforts have the greatest impact.
Our benefits
Work from anywhere
Competitive share options
Health & retirement benefits
Ample PTO and sick leave
Home office stipend
Team off-sites
Generous learning & development budget
Enhanced parental leave
Open positions
All legitimate communication from Mimica will come from an official @mimica.ai email address. While initial outreach may occur through LinkedIn, all formal hiring communication will take place via email. We do not request banking, financial, or sensitive personal information (such as Social Security Number or ID documents) during the recruiting process.
